pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Available only on a dedicated server with the event enabled. Join through its normal interface; ordinary singleplayer does not require this quest.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Blood Moon uses personal successful completion. Boundaries, participants, spectators and temporary terrain recovery remain event-owned.
